# TracedOptions interface

Options for the `traced` method decorator. Every field is optional at the call site — `traced()` takes a `Partial` of this and fills the rest in.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface TracedOptions 
```

_(Optional)_ Extra attributes to set on every span the decorator creates. Applied after the automatic ones, so a key used here overrides the automatic value — including `resource.name`<!-- -->, if you want to name the operation yourself.
